boot.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached, or signing in through your account did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist in Mail.

account.noKeyTitle: Your mail address is not set up yet
account.noKey: Your address key is made when you open your account once.

padlock.verified: End-to-end encrypted, from a verified sender
padlock.zeroAccess: Stored with zero-access encryption: encrypted the moment it arrived
padlock.sentZeroAccess: Sent with zero-access encryption: your copy is encrypted, the recipient's is not
padlock.pgpSigned: Signed message; the signature could not be checked
padlock.pgpSignedVerified: Signed by a verified sender; not end-to-end encrypted

list.noMatchesHint: Search looks at subjects, senders and recipients.

read.pick: Choose a message to read it.
read.cannotOpen: This message could not be opened with your address key.
read.signatureFailed: This message's signature does not match its sender's keys. It may not be from them.
read.remoteBlocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
read.trustKeyDescription: Trust it to check that their messages are from them. Mail to them is then encrypted to this key. Fingerprint: {{fingerprint}}
read.replaceKeyDescription: It is not the key you trust for them. Only trust it if you know they changed their key. Fingerprint: {{fingerprint}}
read.trustFailed: The key could not be saved to Contacts.
read.pgpSignatureFailed: This message's signature does not match the key you trust for its sender. It may not be from them.
read.autoReply: This message was written automatically in answer to an earlier message.

actions.deleteForeverDescription_one: It is removed from your mail and its storage is freed. This cannot be undone.
actions.deleteForeverDescription_other: They are removed from your mail and their storage is freed. This cannot be undone.

compose.subject: Subject
compose.attachmentsFailed: The draft's attachments could not be opened.
compose.attachmentsPending: Wait until the attachments have uploaded, or remove the ones that failed.
compose.tooLarge: Attachments can be 25 MB at most in all.
compose.unknownRecipient: {{address}} is not an address on this server.
compose.notDeliveredFull: Sent, but not delivered to {{addresses}}: their storage is full.
compose.notSentRefused: Sent, but the mail server refused it for {{addresses}}.
compose.sendLimit: You have reached the sending limit. Try again later.
compose.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
compose.sendingPaused: Mail to outside addresses is paused for your account. Ask your administrator.
compose.sendLimitNew: New accounts can send to {{perDay}} outside addresses a day in their first week. Try again later.
compose.pausedNotice: Mail to outside addresses is paused for your account; mail to Kutup users still goes.
compose.pinnedKeyUnusable: The key you trust for {{address}} can no longer be used. Replace or remove it in Contacts.
compose.keyLookupFailed: Keys for {{address}} could not be looked up. Try again.

lock.lookupFailed: Encryption keys could not be looked up
lock.pinned: End-to-end encrypted with a key you trust
lock.pinnedUnusable: The key you trust for this address can no longer be used

found.wkd: End-to-end encrypted with a key from the recipient's domain (Web Key Directory)
found.proton: End-to-end encrypted with the recipient's Proton key
found.keysOpenpgp: End-to-end encrypted with a key from keys.openpgp.org

lock.readableKutup: Not end-to-end encrypted for this message: encrypted when it arrives
lock.readableOutside: Not encrypted for this message: plain mail

compose.outsideOffNotice: This server doesn't send mail to addresses outside Kutup yet. Mail to Kutup addresses goes as usual.
compose.outsideOff: Mail to addresses outside Kutup isn't available on this server yet. Remove them to send to the Kutup addresses.
compose.groupNotAllowed: {{address}} only takes mail from its members or managers.
compose.noGroupShare: You hold no copy of this mailbox's current key. Ask one of its managers to add you again.
compose.encryptOn: Encrypted end to end for every recipient who can receive it. Turn off for this message.
compose.encryptOff: Not encrypted end to end. Turn on.
compose.signOn: Signed with your key, so recipients can check it is from you. Turn off for this message.
compose.notEncryptedKutup: Not end-to-end encrypted: Kutup can read this message while delivering it to Kutup recipients, then stores it encrypted. Lists and shared mailboxes still get it end to end.
compose.notEncrypted: Not encrypted: recipients outside Kutup get plain mail.

emptyHint.inbox: Mail from Kutup users arrives end-to-end encrypted; mail from anyone else is encrypted the moment it arrives.
emptyHint.drafts: Messages you start and do not send are kept here, encrypted.
emptyHint.sent: What you send is kept here, encrypted with your key.
emptyHint.starred: Star a message to find it here.
emptyHint.archive: Archive keeps mail out of the inbox without deleting it.
emptyHint.spam: Mail that looks like spam lands here.
emptyHint.trash: Deleted mail waits here until you delete it for good.
emptyHint.all: Every message except Spam and Trash.
emptyHint.folder: Drag mail here, or use Move to.
emptyHint.label: Add it to mail with Label as.

keys.drag: Drop on a folder to move

places.noFoldersHint: Make folders to file mail by project, person or anything you like.
places.noLabelsHint: Labels are coloured tags; a message can have several and keeps them wherever it is filed.
places.newFolderHint: Name your new folder and choose the folder to put it in. Without one, it is made at the top level.
places.nameTooLong: A name is 100 characters at most.
places.folderNameTaken: A folder with this name is already there.
places.labelNameTaken: A label with this name already exists.
places.deleteFolderDescription: {{name}} and the folders in it are deleted. Their mail is not: it moves to Archive.
places.deleteLabelDescription: {{name}} is removed from your mail. The mail itself stays where it is.
places.settingsDescription: Their names are encrypted in your browser: the server only knows them by number.
places.foldersHint: Drag a folder onto another to put it inside, or above or below one to reorder. Folders go three deep.
places.sortFoldersDescription: Your folders, and the folders inside each, are put in alphabetical order.
places.sortLabelsDescription: Your labels are put in alphabetical order.
places.unreadable_one: {{count}} name could not be opened with your account key.
places.unreadable_other: {{count}} names could not be opened with your account key.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Add a filter to file mail as it arrives: move it, label it, mark it read or star it. Filters run on the server, so they work while Mail is closed; their names are encrypted in your browser.
filters.dialogHint: Filters look at the sender, the recipients, the subject and attachments. Message bodies are encrypted, so no filter can read them.
filters.name: Filter name
filters.nameTaken: A filter with this name already exists.
filters.matchesHint: * for any text, ? for one character
filters.conditionsRequired: Add at least one condition, each with a value.
filters.previewHint: Filters run on mail as it arrives and on the copies you send, never on mail filed as spam.
filters.deleteDescription: {{name}} no longer files new mail. Mail it filed stays where it is.
filters.applyDescription: Its actions are applied to all your mail outside Drafts, Spam and Trash. Nothing is sent.
filters.applying: Filters are being applied. This might take a few minutes.
filters.applyFailed: Applying the filters stopped. Try again.
filters.emptyHint: Add a filter to file mail automatically, or use "Always move sender’s emails" in Move to.
filters.orderHint: Filters run in this order: drag to reorder. Labels and flags add up; the first filter that moves a message decides where it goes.
filters.senderMoved: Mail from {{who}} will be moved to {{place}}.

emptyFolder.description: All of it is deleted for good and its storage freed. This cannot be undone.
emptyFolder.autoDeleteOffer: Automatically delete messages that have been in Trash and Spam for more than 30 days.
emptyFolder.autoDeleteOn: Messages that have been in Trash and Spam more than 30 days will be automatically deleted.

general.title: General
general.autoDeleteHint: Delete Trash and Spam messages after 30 days. Turning it on counts messages already there from now.
general.almostAllMailHint: All mail then shows everything except what is in Spam and Trash.
general.conversationsHint: Group emails in the same conversation together in your mailbox, or display them separately.
general.signOutsideHint: New mail to people outside Kutup starts signed with your key, so they can check it came from you. Mail between Kutup users always starts signed. You can still turn Sign off for one message.

senders.title: Block and allow
senders.description: Decide what happens to mail from an address or a whole domain, before any filter runs.

help.spam: to keep junk mail out of your inbox; it goes to Spam.
help.block: to stop mail you never want: it is not delivered and is deleted, and the sender is not told.
help.allow: so important mail never ends up in Spam (only when the message really comes from that address or domain).

senders.placeholder: Address or domain, like news@shop.example or shop.example
senders.invalid: Enter an address (name@example.com) or a domain (example.com).

added.spam: Mail from {{who}} will go to Spam.

senders.emptyHint: Add an address or domain above, or use "Block messages from this sender" on a message.
senders.blockDescription: New emails from {{who}} won’t be delivered and will be permanently deleted.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: How your mail from {{address}} is signed off.
identity.displayNameHint: The name people see next to your address.
identity.nameTooLong: A display name is 100 characters at most.
identity.signatureHint: Added to new messages, replies and forwards, above the quoted message. Bold, italic, lists and links.
identity.signatureTooLong: The signature is too long (10 KB at most).

autoReply.title: Auto-reply
autoReply.description: Answer mail automatically while you are away or cannot reply.
autoReply.off: Off. Turn it on to choose when it answers and what it says.
autoReply.answeringNow: On: mail that reaches your inbox now gets this answer, once per sender every 7 days.
autoReply.outsideSchedule: On, but outside its schedule now: it answers again when the next period starts.

explain.fixed: Auto-reply is active from the start time to the end time.
explain.daily: Auto-reply is always active on the days of the week you select, between the selected hours.
explain.weekly: Auto-reply is active each week between the selected start and end time.
explain.monthly: Auto-reply is active each month between the selected start and end time.
explain.permanent: Auto-reply is active until you turn it off.

autoReply.readableHint: Kutup sends this answer for you while you are away, so the server keeps its text readable, as Proton does. Images are left out.
autoReply.defaultMessage: I'm out of the office with limited access to my email.
autoReply.tooLong: The message is too long. Shorten it to fit within 10 KB.
autoReply.messageRequired: Write the message to answer with.
autoReply.daysRequired: Choose at least one day of the week.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.layoutHint: Where a message opens: beside the list, or below it.
appearance.composerHint: How a new message opens: as a window over your mail, or full screen.
appearance.densityHint: How much of the list fits on screen.
